reason: The patch adds the same five-line ROLLING_UPDATES gate (isFeatureEnabled, printFeatureDisabled(), picocli.exit(FEATURE_DISABLED), return) to UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:46-50 and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:46-50.
